name: DOF: Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Queens – FY 2011/2012
description:
This dataset contains condominium valuation records from the New York City Department of Finance for Queens, covering fiscal year 2011/2012. Each row represents one condominium property and includes its location identifiers (borough, block, lot, address, ZIP code, coordinates, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number, and neighborhood), along with physical characteristics such as building classification, total units, year built, and gross square footage. For each condominium, the data also provides estimated financial figures: gross income, expenses, net operating income, full market value, and per-square-foot versions of these metrics.

A key feature is that each condominium record is paired with up to three comparable rental buildings used in the valuation process. For each comparable, the dataset lists its address, neighborhood, building classification, unit count, year built, square footage, income and expense estimates, market value, and distance from the condominium in miles. This makes the dataset useful
